notes.title: New Idle RPG Game Coming Soon to Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Folks,
I'm very pleased to announce that the page of our new game is finally available on Steam! 💀🏝️

I’m developing an Idle Creature Collecting RPG with Farming Features 🔥🍃🐾

🐊 Wishlist now! http://https://bit.ly/40Monster

[b][/b]

[h3]Collect all creatures of Arcadius[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/extras/Collection.png?t=1676161141[/img]

[h3]
Defeat and capture Epic Creatures[/h3]

[/h3]

[b][/b]


[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] ⚔️A Casual and Relaxing Idle RPG Game;
[*] 🏝️ Beautiful Graphics and Relaxing Ambience;
[*] 🦊 Manage your team to battle and capture ever more creatures;
[*] 🔨 Buy upgrades to get stronger and defeat all opponents;
[*] 📦 Choose your creatures according to different demands;
[*] ⛏️ Many items for you to discover and use;
[*] 🎒 Fully interactive Crafting/Inventory System;
[*] 🌟 Game content that continues to grow through expansions.
[/list]
